one_line: A local notebook: canvas, page and mind-map notes with ink, voice, keyword and meaning search, secure notes and agent edits (FastHTML + JS).
verdict: Not the same way today: storage, search, voice, background work and the shell are there and often faster, but the editing heart (objects on a canvas, Markdown on a canvas, mind maps, ink tied to text) is missing.

wins.what: Keyword search and opening a big notebook
wins.evidence: Jot vs SQLite-wasm on OPFS at 1M notes: search p95 64.6 vs 165.8 ms (2.6×), cold open 65.8 vs 435.3 ms (6.6×), goal 42. Personal Note itself uses server-side SQLite, so against it: unproven.

wins.what: Search by meaning in one process on the GPU
wins.evidence: Recall: top-10 over 1M in 2.2 ms, 7.7 ms p95 as you type (goal 44, unmerged branch). Personal Note scores in a Python loop; at 1M its per-row loop takes seconds per query (D-1519, 3 queries). The side C race against its llama.cpp helper has no recorded result yet: unproven.
whisper-large-v3-turbo in process: 140 ms vs transformers.js 912 ms, same WER (goal 43). Against Personal Note's nemo-speech server over a WebSocket: unmeasured.

wins.what: Pan and zoom with lots of ink
wins.evidence: Sketch: pan, zoom and draw p95 ≤ 3.5 ms with 101k points (goal 40). The older audit quotes Personal Note's zoom p95 as 97 ms, on another machine: not a fair race yet.

wins.what: Saving on close and running with the window closed
wins.evidence: App.closing() runs in the same process (no 64 KiB keepalive request, no server lingering after close); background mode, tray and notifications checked (goal 45). Personal Note stops voice when the window closes.

wins.what: Agent access without writing a CLI
wins.evidence: Every omxcode app is MCP tools through the agent host (docs/agent.md); Personal Note hand-wrote a 470-line CLI and 60 routes.

Personal Note is Python server + JS page + llama.cpp + nemo-speech processes over loopback; omxcode runs UI, search, embeddings and speech in one process (docs/probes.md). Fewer moving parts is measured in lines only in goal 44 M5, not yet recorded.
